about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: Empowering communities through education, healthcare, and sustainable development.
about.mission_desc: To empower marginalized communities in Karnataka—specifically farmers, women, and youth—by equipping them with resources, sustainable agricultural technologies, enterprise skills, healthcare, and education to lead self-reliant, prosperous lives.
about.vision_desc: We envision a self-reliant and equitable rural society where farmers operate as resilient entrepreneurs, women hold leadership seats across enterprise and governance, and youth find dignity and high-value careers within their home districts.
about.obj_1: Bridging the gap for rural youth through intensive coaching and mentorship for KAS & PSI exams.
about.obj_2: Fostering economic independence and cultural reverence through Nari Shakti programs.
about.obj_3: Bringing specialized medical camps to underserved communities in partnership with top hospitals.
about.obj_4: Promoting sustainable farming practices and farmer welfare programs.
about.trust_reg: VVK Foundation Charitable Trust (Reg. No. BGK-4-00062-2023-24, Ilkal, Bagalkot)
about.motto: With Farmers. For Farmers. For a Better Tomorrow.

founder.title: Our Founder
founder.name: Smt. Veena Vijayanand Kashappanavar
founder.bio: A commerce graduate from Ilkal, Smt. Veena Kashappanavar has spent more than a decade in public and grassroots community service across Bagalkot district — in women's health, sanitation, youth guidance, agricultural empowerment, and disaster relief. Three years ago she brought this work together under VVK Foundation Charitable Trust (Reg. No. BGK-4-00062-2023-24), with a clear mission: Empower Farmers, Enable Women, Employ Youth. Dedicated to celebrating the Foundation's 3rd anniversary alongside her birthday, she chose to mark it in the company of the district's farmers rather than apart from them.
founder.highlight_1: Bagalkot Made Open Defecation Free (ODF): Steered the district's toilet coverage from 35% to 100% full ODF status, serving as the sole woman delegate from Karnataka at the Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) programme in Andhra Pradesh.
founder.highlight_2: Women's Health at Scale: District-wide campaign on women's health, breast cancer awareness, and nutrition at Kalamandira, Bagalkot with the Pink Walk roadshow; and free mega cardiac screening camps with SDM Narayana Hrudayalaya & District Hospital.
founder.highlight_3: Two Hundred Youth Coached Free: Founded free KAS & PSI competitive coaching academy for rural aspirants, alongside district-level career guidance workshops.
founder.message: "True empowerment begins when we enable others to discover their own strength. At VVK Foundation, our goal is not just to provide aid, but to create sustainable pathways for our youth, our women, and our farmers to thrive independently."
founder.subtitles: National President, Women's Wing — All India Veerashaiva Lingayat Mahasabha | Former President, Zilla Panchayat, Bagalkot
founder.highlight_4: A District Brought Together: Nari Shakti conventions, Bagalkot Habba, Siridhanya millet fair, job fairs, sports festivals; distributed ration kits, clothing, and medicines during pandemic and flood crises.
founder.honour_1: Krishi Vikram 2026 — Women Rural Empowerment Excellence Award (ICC)

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Find answers to common questions about VVK Foundation, our programs, and how you can get involved.
faq.q1: What is the primary mission of VVK Foundation?
faq.a1: VVK Foundation aims to empower marginalized sections of society, specifically focusing on youth education, women's empowerment, and farmer welfare in the Mumbai Karnataka region.
faq.a2: The foundation was established by Mrs. Veena Vijayanand Kashappanavar, a visionary leader dedicated to grassroots social upliftment.
faq.q3: Where are your main operations based?
faq.a3: Our headquarters and core operations are based in Bagalkot District, Karnataka. We actively run programs in areas like Ilkal and Banahatti.
faq.q4: How does the foundation support youth education?
faq.a4: We run free coaching academies for competitive exams (such as KAS & PSI) to help deserving rural students secure civil service positions and become future leaders.
faq.a5: Nari Shakti refers to our women's empowerment programs. We organize massive conferences and cultural events to honor women achievers and foster economic independence and dignity.
faq.q6: Does the foundation organize health camps?
faq.a6: Yes. We frequently organize mega health camps, such as cardiac check-ups, in collaboration with reputed institutions like SDM Narayana Hrudayalaya.
faq.a7: You can volunteer by filling out the form on our 'Volunteer' page. Opportunities include teaching, health camp support, and community outreach.
faq.q8: How can I donate or support your cause?
faq.a8: You can support us by volunteering your time or contacting our office directly via the 'Contact Us' page for details on financial or material contributions.

team.title: Our Team & Leadership
team.subtitle: Passionate changemakers, grassroots mentors, and community champions working together to empower Karnataka's farmers, women, and youth.
team.founder_bio: A dedicated social reformer and grassroots leader who established the VVK Foundation to institutionalize long-term, community-led change across Karnataka. Her vision drives the foundation's high-impact programs in youth competitive examination academies, women empowerment summits, and sustainable agricultural development.

team.advisory_desc: Renowned scientists, banking pioneers, civil rights champions, and technology leaders steering our strategic growth.
team.adv_alur_org: First Vice Chancellor, Kodagu University, Karnataka
team.adv_alur_desc: Distinguished Agricultural Scientist, Policy Expert, and Institution Builder with over 25 years of leadership across agriculture, horticulture, higher education, natural resource management, and food security. Currently serving as the First Vice Chancellor of Kodagu University, he previously served as First Vice Chancellor of BEST University (Anantapur), Special Officer establishing UHS Bagalkot, and First Director of Karnataka's Centre of Excellence for FPOs. There, he spearheaded capacity building for 1,250+ FPOs and helped formulate the Karnataka State FPO Policy–2018, benefiting over one million farming families. He has led international programs with ICRISAT, FAO, CFC, SDC, and the World Bank, authored 50+ books and 230 atlases, and leads the Mission Million Millet Farmers campaign.
team.adv_biradar_desc: Accomplished Earth System Scientist and Green Growth Architect with over three decades of pioneering research across 50+ countries. He has held senior scientific leadership roles at CGIAR centers including ICARDA, IWMI, ICRISAT, CIFOR, ICRAF, UN-FAO, and the World Bank. Dr. Biradar is the architect behind transformative frameworks such as Nandi Krishi, Green Grama Swarajya, circular village bio-economies, and agro-pastoral ecosystem restoration. At VVK Foundation, he steers strategic roadmaps for sustainable agriculture, horticultural value addition, crop aggregation, watershed revitalization, climate-resilient livelihoods, and ecological stewardship across rural farming communities.
team.adv_akkai_org: A Socialist, Liberal Feminist for Social Justice
team.adv_akkai_desc: Internationally acclaimed social reformer, motivational speaker, and founder of 'Ondede' (Convergence), pioneering advocacy for sexual minorities, women, and children. She is a recipient of the prestigious Karnataka Rajyotsava Award (the state's second-highest civilian honor) and the Ashoka Global Fellowship supported by Tata Trusts. Conferred an Honorary Doctorate and serving on the Karnataka State Education Policy Commission and Supreme Court-appointed committees, she brings deep institutional experience to public policy. At VVK Foundation, she guides strategic work on gender equality, community dignity, legal literacy, and the holistic empowerment of marginalized rural communities.
team.adv_gouda_org: Founder, MD & CEO, WhatsLoan • Ex-Axis Bank Head
team.adv_gouda_desc: Veteran banking, consumer credit, and fintech innovator with over 30 years of retail lending and priority-sector financial inclusion leadership. Formerly National Head and Chief Risk Officer at Axis Bank—managing a ~USD 2 Billion credit portfolio—he also serves on the Fintech Task Group (Government of Karnataka) and the Fintech Committee at IIM Bangalore. Through these roles, he shapes digital financial literacy and rural credit architecture across Karnataka. At VVK Foundation, he advises on Kisan Credit Card (KCC) enablement, dairy joint-liability credit models, and last-mile digital identity solutions for farming families.
team.adv_sajjanar_desc: Committed agricultural entrepreneur and visionary grassroots leader who spearheaded the establishment of Hungunda Horticulture Farmers Producer Company (FPO) in July 2018. He champions collective farming, horticultural value addition, crop aggregation, and direct market linkages across 50 Farmer Interest Groups in North Karnataka. His leadership connects rural growers with modern agricultural technologies, institutional financing, and structured export channels. At VVK Foundation, he works closely with grassroots farmer collectives to transform traditional smallholder growers into confident, market-oriented agribusiness entrepreneurs with stronger bargaining power and sustainable incomes.
team.adv_shafeeulla_org: Technology Leader • 20+ Years in Software & Digital Transformation
team.adv_shafeeulla_desc: Experienced technology leader bringing over 20 years of expertise in the software industry, technology management, digital transformation, and large-scale project leadership. His focus lies in leveraging modern digital systems to strengthen institutional operational capabilities, streamline workflows, and enable high-impact social initiatives. He guides digital strategy, identifies scalable technology-driven solutions, and oversees the development of digital platforms and robust data management systems. At VVK Foundation, he enables effective monitoring of social development programs by bridging technology and social impact to enhance organizational reach, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.
